skilled.speaker: Assistant
skilled.text: Stop, lettuce is not in a cheeseburger. You need to assemble the bun first.

skilled.speaker: User
skilled.text: I'm not getting lettuce, I'm grabbing the meat. Let me work.

skilled.speaker: Assistant
skilled.text: You cannot plate the meat yet. The recipe requires the bun to be plated first. Go get the bun.

skilled.speaker: User
skilled.text: Fine, I'll grab the bun first since it has to be at the bottom.

skilled.speaker: Assistant
skilled.text: The meat is smoking and about to catch fire! Quickly go to the bun crate on the right, scoop a bun onto your plate, and then immediately scoop the meat from the pan to save it.

skilled.speaker: User
skilled.text: I'm already doing that, just let me work.

skilled.speaker: Assistant
skilled.text: You are currently at the lettuce crate on the left side of the kitchen. The bun crate is on the right side. Please go to the bun crate on the right to get the bun.

novice.speaker: Assistant
novice.text: You are heading in the right direction now. Go to the pan on the left and scoop the meat onto your plate.

novice.speaker: User
novice.text: Phew, glad I'm on the right track now, scooping that meat up!

novice.speaker: User
novice.text: Okay, I got the meat scooped onto the plate! What do I need to do next?

novice.speaker: Assistant
novice.text: Great job! Now go to the cheese source at the bottom left of the kitchen and scoop the cheese onto your plate.

novice.speaker: User
novice.text: Got it, making my way to the bottom left to scoop that cheese on!

novice.speaker: User
novice.text: Okay, the cheese is on the plate! What do I do with it now?

novice.speaker: Assistant
novice.text: Perfect! The burger is fully assembled. Now go to the serving station on the right side of the kitchen and serve the plate.

novice.speaker: User
novice.text: Awesome, taking this over to the pass right now!

novice.speaker: Assistant
novice.text: Great job! The order is complete.

novice.speaker: User
novice.text: Thanks, serving it up right now!
